effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may place 1 Digimon card with [Knightmon] in its name or [Bagra Army] trait from your hand or trash under this Digimon as its top digivolution card. Then, if [Tuwarmon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 3 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[On Deletion] You may return up to 2 black and/or purple Digimon cards from your Trash to your hand.
xros_req:
DigiXros Requirements [DigiXros -2] [DarkKnightmon] x [Tuwarmon] 
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
